content: Customer Akanksha Bhatt contacted agent Karan Joshi because her auto policy (AP-123456) expired on the day of the call. She inquired about reinstatement options versus getting a new policy to ensure coverage for the next day. The agent explained the 30-day reinstatement window, fees, and that same-day reinstatement takes effect within an hour of payment. After discussing deductibles and potential loss of no-claims discounts for a new policy, the customer opted to reinstate her existing policy. The agent provided a payment link for the total amount of $152.75.

action_items: Agent to email payment link to the customer
Customer to complete the $152.75 payment via credit card or net-banking
Agent to process same-day policy reinstatement upon payment
